---
name: ci

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions: {}

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Lint
        run: make lint

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - name: Test
        run: make test

---
name: codeql

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * 1"

permissions: {}

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: python
      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3

# pinning-demo

Runs lint, tests, and a scheduled CodeQL analysis.

## Keeping GitHub Actions up to date

Workflow steps reference actions by full commit SHA, with the corresponding
version as a trailing comment (e.g. `actions/checkout@fbc6f39... # v5.1.0`).
Pinning to a SHA instead of a mutable tag like `@v5` ensures a workflow run
always uses the exact code that was reviewed.

[Dependabot](.github/dependabot.yml) is configured to check the actions used
in `.github/workflows` weekly. When a new release is available, it opens a
single pull request that updates the pinned SHA (and version comment) for
every action that has a new version that week, rather than one PR per
action. Review and merge that PR to pick up the update.

+## Keeping GitHub Actions up to date
+
+Workflow steps reference actions by full commit SHA, with the corresponding
+version as a trailing comment (e.g. `actions/checkout@fbc6f39... # v5.1.0`).
+Pinning to a SHA instead of a mutable tag like `@v5` ensures a workflow run
+always uses the exact code that was reviewed.
+
+[Dependabot](.github/dependabot.yml) is configured to check the actions used
+in `.github/workflows` weekly. When a new release is available, it opens a
+single pull request that updates the pinned SHA (and version comment) for
+every action that has a new version that week, rather than one PR per
+action. Review and merge that PR to pick up the update.
